# S402 — B-Matrix Summary (Leontief Inverse)

**Chapter**: 4. **Status**: validated_book_and_extension. **Units**: matrix_summary.

Leontief inverse B = (I-A)^-1 per benchmark year, with summary statistics: n_sectors, max_b_element, b_column_sum_max, b_trace, b_frobenius_norm.

Frobenius norm range [10.47, 103.02] — high in 1947 (due to near-singular A), normal range otherwise. B trace ≥ n_sectors at every year (B = I + A + A² + ... so diagonal ≥ 1).
